_comment: Full-dataset runs for the 2026-08-30 two-tower sweep, chosen from the
pilot in pilot.json.
1. budget-8ep is ADR 0006's configuration exactly, given up to eight
epochs instead of three with early stopping on a loss plateau. It
answers 'was three epochs too little?' directly. Because the config
and the seed are v1's, its first three epoch losses reproduce v1's
10.3542 -> 10.2726 -> 10.2718 exactly, which doubles as the check
that this PR's memory rewrite moved no number. It ran all eight and
ended at warm recall@500 0.0451, below the three-epoch 0.0466.
2. lr1e-2-t0.05-8ep was launched and then stopped about a minute in,
before its first epoch, once cell 1 turned out to cost 21-26 minutes
per epoch and to run all eight of them: eight more would not have fit
in the day. Its MLflow run is marked KILLED and nothing was measured
and then discarded. It was relaunched at four epochs from full2.json,
which is the run docs/results.md reports.
Early stopping uses min_delta 1e-4 rather than something larger on
purpose: v1's third epoch improved by 0.0008, and a threshold above that
would have stopped the budget run at exactly the point it exists to get
past. In the event it never fired at all — the loss kept creeping down in
the fourth decimal for all eight epochs.
